title: Accelerating structural optimization via EIFEM: a ROM-based preconditioner
summary: Topology optimization (TopOpt) is a standard tool for structural conceptual design, providing optimal structures with great design freedom. However, it has a high computational costs due to the repeated evaluation of high-fidelity finite element models and frequently produces complex geometries that require extensive interpretation for manufacturability. As an alternative, this work presents a parameterized optimization framework based on Reduced Order Modeling (ROM) and preconditioning techniques.
